author: Primary Pivoter3 — advisory synthesis

coverage.basis: Nine transferred Grok packets, separate supplied Hermes/Opik framing, earlier recovered local-AI roundup assessment. Companion ten-tool catalog linked, not counted again.
coverage.originals: Kept unchanged; this is a new assessment, not a replacement for source packets.
coverage.limits: Selected primary documentation and transferred framing, not every historical hyperlink, full source-code audit, benchmark replication or executable qualification. Article and social-pointer gaps remain explicit.

interpretation: source_finding distinguishes source-derived content from proposed_leverage, adoption_gate and acceptance_test, which are PP3 design recommendations.
source_versions: arXiv v1 is explicit. Other upstream links may change; no executable release is selected. Pin and qualify any actual component before use.
hard_constraints: Current source access before retrieval and reuse
No repeated external effect from a missing reply
No private evaluator answers or credentials in traces
No source instruction treated as authority
Existing specialist and execution boundaries remain

reuse_card_proposal.rule: A second authorized consumer must actually apply the accepted version and return evidence; a shared link or summary is not reuse.

measurement.baseline: Comparable real tasks; preserve denominator and evaluation version.
measurement.benefit: Measured valid-reuse effort avoided minus verification and maintenance cost; no exponential rate is asserted.

publication_requirement: Expose the human page and machine catalog through the existing supported website content path, verify exact version and actual URL, then record reader/use receipts separately. No new portal, signing repair or deployment permission follows.
next_action: Preserve current correction/review priority. Use the instruction/trace/team methods in the next scoped work-order revision; choose at most one new runtime only for a proven remaining gap.

items.title: Astra guidance and Voxyz review framing
items.source_finding: Official guidance favors precise skill triggers and progressive disclosure. Grok supplied Voxyz as a non-mutating review pointer, not an official policy.
items.proposed_leverage: Keep one small current-state router, load task-relevant evidence and define the terminal result for each stage. Review redundant instructions without deleting necessary evidence or weakening controls.
items.adoption_gate: A scoped instruction change needs its own review; this catalog changes no active prompt or permission.
items.acceptance_test: On comparable authorized tasks, measure finished answers, context bytes, latency and owner interventions while preserving all required checks.

items.title: Meta-Harness
items.source_finding: The paper and author page describe improving harness code using retained code, scores and execution traces. A main framework and separate TB2 artifact are available; the original artifact-only assessment is superseded.
items.proposed_leverage: Index failures by operation, source version and violated invariant. Reuse relevant allowed traces to propose one reviewed correction; retain unsuccessful candidates and unseen evaluation cases.
items.adoption_gate: No proposer loop or dependency install. Reported experimental gains do not establish gains here; summaries remain useful indexes.
items.acceptance_test: A second authorized reader traces an existing failure to exact code/input/receipt and uses an accepted correction without replaying its original effects.

items.title: Hermes and Opik
items.source_finding: Grok supplied TWO-PATH: successful work to reusable procedure; failure to trace, diagnosis, diff, human approval and regression. The integration documents session/turn/tool tracing. The article itself was not freshly readable.
items.proposed_leverage: Success creates a candidate method, not immediate authority. Failure or uncertainty preserves causal evidence before a scoped repair. Link task, attempt, review and reuse receipts; collect only permitted telemetry.
items.adoption_gate: Do not install the agents or exporter, export private conversations, relax existing retry rules, or use model judges as substitutes for deterministic financial checks.
items.acceptance_test: Demonstrate one accepted method reused by another role and one failed/unknown operation remaining unaccepted without duplicate side effects.

items.title: Grok Bot 101
items.source_finding: Documents provider bot interaction modes, connections and a persistent computer. Those capabilities do not establish access from our other conversations.
items.proposed_leverage: Maintain a capability register separating documented, configured, observed and qualified behavior. Give every real assignment an actual pickup and result identity.
items.adoption_gate: No new bot, routine, connection or presumed cross-provider API.
items.acceptance_test: One existing assigned bot returns an attributed receipt through an already approved route; absent pickup stays visible.

items.title: Grok Bot for engineering
items.source_finding: Describes specialized bots, engineering delegation and proof of work. The vendor example is not our own execution evidence.
items.proposed_leverage: Make Head Chef coordinate and review; let the existing scoped executor do technical work. Return exact inputs, changed artifacts and proof rather than conversational reassurance.
items.adoption_gate: Use existing Codex; do not assume the article grants Cursor or unattended task access here.
items.acceptance_test: One bounded engineering task reaches a terminal result and receives substantive review with all output identities preserved.

items.title: Grok Bot for support
items.source_finding: The guide describes triage and investigation using specialized responsibilities and evidence.
items.proposed_leverage: Adapt to Worker5 intake: capture the question once, route it, display blocked state, separate research closure from actual answer delivery and acknowledgment.
items.adoption_gate: No new support inbox or duplicate intake; illustrative vendor volumes are not forecasts.
items.acceptance_test: One existing task links intake, assignment, answer and accepted acknowledgment without repeated owner entry.

items.title: Templates for Grok Bot
items.source_finding: Templates are recipes, not exact clones; custom code, credentials and nonstandard dependencies do not automatically transfer.
items.proposed_leverage: Pair role instructions with explicit dependency, evidence and access manifests. A successor should know what is present, missing, permitted and not yet verified.
items.adoption_gate: No template installation, identity transfer or claim that sharing a prompt transfers a working environment.
items.acceptance_test: A same-role reader recovers the current state and identifies missing access without requiring the outgoing chat or rerunning completed work.

items.title: Running multiple teams of Grok Bots
items.source_finding: An experimental multi-team account describes clear roles and shared task coordination.
items.proposed_leverage: Reuse one roster and task ledger, explicit ownership, a shared definition of done and a visible blocked queue. Add a role only for a proven uncovered function.
items.adoption_gate: Do not import the author's organization, Notion stack or bot counts as requirements. No existing specialist authority changes.
items.acceptance_test: Two roles collaborate on one task with no duplicate assignment and with an identifiable reviewer and next actor.

items.title: Ollama
items.source_finding: Model serving and embeddings are documented. Local API access does not itself require authentication.
items.proposed_leverage: A possible narrow local generation or embedding worker. Keep semantic search as a rebuildable locator over authorized records; retrieve the exact accepted version before use.
items.adoption_gate: Need an actual workload, hardware, model license and supported authenticated bridge. Do not expose an unauthenticated port or install redundant servers.
items.acceptance_test: Retrieve one reviewed method and reject stale/revoked records; compare quality, runtime and total cost with the existing method.

items.title: LocalAI
items.source_finding: Provides multiple serving backends and documented agent, knowledge and tool facilities.
items.proposed_leverage: Consider instead of a narrower server only when its capabilities remove a named missing implementation. Preserve our coordinator and independent review boundary.
items.adoption_gate: Pin components, principal, destinations and costs; advertised agent autonomy is not admitted authority.
items.acceptance_test: The same fixed task has a bounded submitted/running/terminal lifecycle and returns exact artifacts under denied-action tests.

items.title: ComfyUI
items.source_finding: The documented prompt endpoint returns a job identifier; queue, history and WebSocket routes expose state and results.
items.proposed_leverage: Use as a candidate visual-job executor below the Control Room: pin workflow, scene inputs and outputs, then qualify a separate Gaussian viewer/query consumer.
items.adoption_gate: Required custom nodes are executable dependencies. No demonstrated Gaussian compatibility; interrupt semantics must be checked on an isolated job, not assumed to target any arbitrary shared job.
items.acceptance_test: One lawful scene job returns identified assets and status; a second consumer retrieves the same version and verifies a scene-grounded answer.

items.title: llama.cpp
items.source_finding: C/C++ language-model inference and serving primitives.
items.proposed_leverage: Choose when a named task needs engine-level control not supplied by the selected wrapper; retain identical input/output contracts.
items.adoption_gate: Not an extra service by default; verify backend, model terms, resource limits and actual hardware.
items.acceptance_test: Same fixed job meets quality and memory/time limits with no additional unapproved network effects.

items.title: whisper.cpp
items.source_finding: Native Whisper inference for local speech transcription.
items.proposed_leverage: Optional permitted-recording intake with audio-linked transcript drafts. Select this or the companion Whisper option rather than both without a reason.
items.adoption_gate: Recording rights, model/hardware limits and review of important names, numbers and quotations remain required.
items.acceptance_test: One authorized clip is checked against audio, including silence and a numeric passage; transcript errors remain explicit.

items.title: Jan
items.source_finding: Desktop local-model chat and API facilities.
items.proposed_leverage: Possible owner workstation client or comparison baseline, not another primary project intake channel.
items.adoption_gate: Only adopt for a demonstrated workstation need; no duplicate task store or claimed shared hosted memory.
items.acceptance_test: One permitted local task exports provenance-preserving output into the existing records.

items.title: GPT4All
items.source_finding: Local desktop models and LocalDocs retrieval.
items.proposed_leverage: A possible local retrieval baseline, not a replacement for accepted-version, access-filtered team evidence.
items.adoption_gate: Only approved documents; do not bulk import private archives into a new store.
items.acceptance_test: Compare retrieval on permitted notes and verify exact-source access after retrieval; revoked material is excluded.

items.title: TextGen / text-generation-webui
items.source_finding: Model experimentation, serving and extensions; the upstream name redirects to TextGen.
items.proposed_leverage: A controlled comparison environment when a serving/model question cannot be answered with the chosen runtime.
items.adoption_gate: No production control plane or arbitrary extension installation.
items.acceptance_test: Compare one fixed workload under the same evaluation and explicit plugin/version inventory.

items.title: MLX-LM
items.source_finding: Apple-silicon language-model inference and fine-tuning.
items.proposed_leverage: Candidate only for an existing approved compatible host and a justified job.
items.adoption_gate: Do not infer Windows support, buy hardware or authorize fine-tuning from this listing.
items.acceptance_test: Record actual compatible host and compare one job against the existing executor before adoption.

items.title: exo
items.source_finding: Distributed inference; the reviewed platform document prioritizes Apple Silicon and lists Windows as a longer-term objective.
items.proposed_leverage: Potential later compute scaling across authorized supported machines when measurements justify network overhead.
items.adoption_gate: Does not pool hosted subscriptions, combine conversations, expand a hosted chat limit or create reviewed shared memory.
items.acceptance_test: Measure one model/job on actual supported hardware; compare latency, memory and network costs without assuming speedup.

items.title: Awesome trading agents
items.source_finding: CC0 curated list organized into Agents, MCPs and Skills; not a single installable toolkit.
items.proposed_leverage: Reuse the vocabulary and component-discovery pattern. Assess each selected child separately against a named function.
items.adoption_gate: No brokerage connections, live keys, trading, inferred child-code safety or forced incident relevance.
items.acceptance_test: One proposed component has a primary source, exact version, capability boundary and non-adoption reason or reviewed plan.

items.title: Maigret
items.source_finding: Username-account discovery utility. Grok reported a denylist decision; project-wide runtime enforcement was not demonstrated.
items.proposed_leverage: Use the exclusion as an admission-policy example: a tool's capability does not establish necessity, authority or identity attribution.
items.adoption_gate: No scanning, installation, bot tool or wallet identification. Any later first-party use needs its own narrowly reviewed purpose.
items.acceptance_test: A proposed runtime tool outside scope is rejected without executing it or collecting personal data.

items.title: Visual General Intelligence white paper
items.source_finding: A plural vision/AGI research agenda spanning visual experience rather than a single installable architecture.
items.proposed_leverage: Expand spatial acceptance criteria beyond attractive views: geometry, camera-dependent evidence, occlusion, contradictions and uncertainty.
items.adoption_gate: No AGI claim, new model or proof that a Gaussian representation supplies physical understanding.
items.acceptance_test: For one lawful scene, an authorized second consumer answers a grounded question and declines one unsupported by available views.

items.title: Galaxy event pointer
items.source_finding: The official page identifies a September 15-17 event and livestream programming.
items.proposed_leverage: Retain only as a place to obtain a primary artifact answering a named interface question, when normal work encounters one.
items.adoption_gate: No registration, event-monitoring task, attendance or proof that a demo works in our system.
items.acceptance_test: A relevant later artifact names the exact contract change and a concrete affected gap; otherwise leave this parked.

items.title: PHIAT competence / honesty framing
items.source_finding: The transferred desk frame separates technical failure, communications evidence and unproven actor attribution. Its incident assertions were not newly substantiated in this review.
items.proposed_leverage: Give claims separate evidence requirements and statuses. A control failure cannot silently become proof of identity or intent.
items.adoption_gate: Preserve accepted specialist cutoffs and findings; publish no new accusation, loss estimate or owner identity from this frame.
items.acceptance_test: A proposed conclusion unsupported by its evidence class stays unproven and cannot alter the accepted record.

items.title: Telegram preview coverage
items.source_finding: Only a public-preview extract was transferred, not a complete publication envelope or full channel history. Fresh direct access did not succeed here.
items.proposed_leverage: Record inspected scope and gaps before making absence claims. Resolve index-versus-extract differences explicitly instead of strengthening them.
items.adoption_gate: No login, joining, additional collection or wallet inference. The extract does not independently support every contract assertion in its index.
items.acceptance_test: An absent term in sampled previews remains scoped to that sample, never converted into a claim about the entire history.
